guidance.bestFor: The smallest setup: 2 triggers on a muted track switching between an account card and a password card
agentNotes: Name and username are `defaultValue` samples and no form wraps any `Input`, so Save changes and Update password send nothing

whenNotToUse.when: A range switch whose chosen period the page reads from state
Dashboard views in place of forms, with an icon on every trigger

guidance.bestFor: An underlined row stretched full width over 3 cards for account, password and preference forms
agentNotes: Theme and Language are free text `Input` fields seeded with Light and English; swap in a select for real options
Save changes, Update password and Save settings are `Button` elements with no handler or form around them

whenNotToUse.when: The underlined style stacked as a column on the left of the panel

guidance.bestFor: A muted column of 3 triggers on the left, with the matching form card opening to its right
agentNotes: Each `Input` is uncontrolled, with Emma Wilson as the sample account, and none of the 3 footer buttons has a handler

whenNotToUse.when: A side column with no muted track, where a thin bar marks the open section

name: c-tabs-4
title: Tabs with vertical orientation and line variant.
label: Vertical Line
description: Tabs with vertical orientation and line variant.

guidance.bestFor: A transparent left column where a thin bar on its right edge marks the active section, beside wider cards
agentNotes: Name, email, theme and language are prefilled through `defaultValue` and the 3 footer buttons do nothing yet

whenNotToUse.when: A side list whose rows each lead with an icon, some ending in a count

guidance.bestFor: User, lock and gear icons ahead of each label on a muted track sized to its content, over 3 form cards
agentNotes: No form element wraps the `Input` fields and the 3 footer `Button` actions have no handler, so nothing is saved yet

whenNotToUse.when: Icon triggers over panels you fill yourself, with no form inside

guidance.bestFor: A full width muted track of Overview, Analytics and Settings with icons, over 1 line placeholder cards
agentNotes: Each `CardContent` holds a 1 line placeholder sentence; put your overview, analytics and settings views there

whenNotToUse.when: Icon triggers over panels that hold edit forms with a save button
A stats period switch whose selection lives in React state

guidance.bestFor: Mail folders on an underlined row, with tinted count badges on Inbox, Drafts and Spam and none on Sent
agentNotes: The 12, 3 and 24 counts are literals in each `Badge` and again in the panel text; derive both from your data

whenNotToUse.when: Sections in a side column, each led by an icon and some carrying a count

name: c-tabs-8
title: Tabs with icons and line variant
label: Side List Icons
description: Tabs with icons and line variant

guidance.bestFor: A side list of Projects, Tasks, Team and Reports, each led by an icon, 2 ending in a right aligned count badge
agentNotes: `plans` and its `tablerIcon` fields are declared but never rendered; delete the constant when adapting
The 8 and 24 counts appear in both a `Badge` and the panel copy, so update them together from one source

whenNotToUse.when: A plain side list of text labels with no icons or counts
Counts on a horizontal row of folders with no icons

guidance.bestFor: A controlled Daily to Yearly switch kept in React state, each panel showing one large visitor total
agentNotes: The 4 visitor totals are fixed text in each `TabsContent`; read `period` to load the figure for the chosen range

whenNotToUse.when: A period switch that filters data shown elsewhere, with no panel of its own
Panels that hold forms with their own save buttons
